verdict.rationale: Lambda's docs describe 1-Click Clusters (16–512 H100/B200 GPUs) with GPUDirect RDMA up to 3200 Gb/s, self-serve instant launch with no long-term commitments, plus Managed Slurm/Kubernetes for multi-node job orchestration — directly matching the story of provisioning fast-interconnect GPU clusters without a sales cycle. Community evidence corroborates self-serve on-demand access (pricing tweet, third-party CLI/agent tooling for launching instances) though it focuses on single instances rather than clusters specifically. Missing for 10: independent hands-on report of actually provisioning a multi-node 1CC cluster and benchmarking interconnect performance.
